## 1.7.4 - 02.04.2025

- Added `set` helper.
- Added `qrcode` helper.

## 1.6.2 - 18.11.2024

- Fix `select` helper.

## 1.6.0 - 05.11.2024

- Added `substr` helper.

## 1.5.0 - 01.11.2024

- `ifCondAnd` helper: Adds support for "AND" conditions, allowing a template block to execute when all checks are true.
- `ifCondOr` helper: Adds support for "OR" conditions, allowing a template block to execute when at least one check is true.
- Enhanced `ifCond` helper: Added handling for different argument types and optimized conditional logic, ensuring correct operation with numerical, string values, and inclusion conditions.

## 1.4.3 - 23.10.2024

- For the helper `select`, a message is displayed if the classifier is not found.

## 1.4.1 - 15.10.2024

- For the `select` helper, a check for an empty value, which is substituted as id, has been added, as well as some other improvements to this helper.

## 1.4.0 - 11.10.2024

- Added new functionality to the `select` helper to fetch data from the database

## 1.3.0 - 26.09.2024

- Added `inc` helper - a convenient helper for creating dynamic numbering.
- Added order parameter for `contentList` helper.
- Helper `select` can now accept arrays and boolean values.

## 1.2.0 - 24.09.2024

- Additional functionality and parameters have been added for the `formatNumber` helper.

## 1.1.0 - 11.08.2024

- Added support for asynchronous helpers using `promised-handlebars`, allowing you to perform asynchronous operations within your Handlebars templates.

- Added new helper: `contentList` for querying and displaying data from a PostgreSQL database within your Handlebars templates.

## 1.0.1 - 06.08.2024

- Added check if already registered handlebars

- formatDate
